"""Observe six fixed V172 EMA forwards without altering predictions or weights."""
import os,time
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np,psutil,torch
from demosaic.late_local_noise_matching import LateLocalNoiseMatchingDetail
from demosaic.prediction_archive import fingerprint
from profile_raw_kernel_inference import model_hash
from train_directional_bank_trial import read,ref,save,guard
repo=Path('/home/dllu/proj/demosaic');root=repo/'.cache/quality-20261107/V174-offset-usage-v1';assert not root.exists();root.mkdir()
plan=read(repo/'.cache/quality-20261107/V172-local-noise-matching-v1/plan-v1.json');guard(plan)
export=read(repo/'docs/results/v172-local-noise-matching-final-v1.json')['checkpoints']['EMA'];assert ref(export['export']['path'])==export['export']
selected=['mesh-seed2026112302-present-iso6400-prior-RGGB','mesh-seed2026112302-absent-iso6400-prior-RGGB','mesh-seed2026112309-present-iso6400-prior-RGGB','main-overcast-sky','mesh-nominal','mesh-profile3879']
design={c['id']:c for c in read(plan['design']['path'])['observations']};scores=read(repo/'.cache/quality-20261107/V172-local-noise-matching-v1/scores-method-labels-v2.json');expected={r['id']:r['values'] for r in scores['rows'] if r['method']=='V172-EMA'}
owner=dict(pid=os.getpid(),created=psutil.Process().create_time());save(root/'protocol-v1.json',dict(owner=owner,source=dict(ref(__file__),text=Path(__file__).read_text()),selected=selected,checkpoint=export,design=plan['design'],expected_wrapper_calls=6,expected_sampler_calls=30,new_training_updates=0,new_source_noise_draws=0,scope='Six reused inputs;offset-displacement observation only. Output fingerprints must replay V172 exactly. Component sample displacements are not whole-model receptive fields or causal RGB contributions.'))
os.nice(10);os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]);torch.set_num_threads(2);torch.set_num_interop_threads(1);torch.set_float32_matmul_precision('highest');torch.backends.cuda.matmul.allow_tf32=torch.backends.cudnn.allow_tf32=False;torch.backends.cudnn.benchmark=False;torch.backends.cudnn.deterministic=True;torch.use_deterministic_algorithms(True,warn_only=True);torch.cuda.set_per_process_memory_fraction(24*2**30/torch.cuda.get_device_properties(0).total_memory);torch.ops.load_library(plan['sampling_library']['path'])
state=torch.load(export['export']['path'],map_location='cpu',weights_only=True);module=LateLocalNoiseMatchingDetail(**state['module_config']);module.load_state_dict(state['state_dict'],strict=True);assert model_hash(module)==export['module_hash'];module.cuda().eval();before=model_hash(module);cpu_rng=torch.get_rng_state().clone();cuda_rng=torch.cuda.get_rng_state().clone()
counts=dict(wrapper=0,frozen=0,network=0,sampler=0);observations=[];captured={}
for name,child in [('wrapper',module),('frozen',module.frozen),('network',module.network)]:child.register_forward_hook(lambda *args,name=name:counts.__setitem__(name,counts[name]+1))
scales={'down1.0':2,'down2.0':4,'body.0':8,'up2.1':4,'up1.1':2}
for name,child in module.network.named_modules():
 if type(child).__name__=='NonlocalBlock':
  child.register_forward_hook(lambda *args:counts.__setitem__('sampler',counts['sampler']+1))
  child.offset_cnn.register_forward_hook(lambda m,a,out,name=name:captured.__setitem__(name,out.detach().cpu().numpy()))
for identifier in selected:
 case=design[identifier];assert ref(case['arrays']['path'])==case['arrays'] and ref(case['parent']['path'])==case['parent'];a=dict(np.load(case['arrays']['path']));batch={k:torch.from_numpy(a[k]).cuda() for k in ['packed','variance','colors','wb']};base=torch.from_numpy(np.load(case['parent']['path'])).cuda();captured.clear()
 with torch.inference_mode():output=module(base,*(batch[k] for k in ['packed','variance','colors','wb']))
 value=output.cpu().numpy();assert fingerprint(value)==expected[identifier] and set(captured)==set(scales);blocks=[]
 for name,raw in captured.items():
  n,c,h,w=raw.shape;assert n==1 and c==18;offset=9*np.tanh(raw.astype(np.float64).reshape(1,9,2,h,w));grid=np.asarray([(y,x) for y in [-1,0,1] for x in [-1,0,1]],np.float64).reshape(1,9,2,1,1);disp=(offset+grid)*scales[name];distance=np.sqrt(np.sum(disp**2,axis=2));learned=np.sqrt(np.sum((offset*scales[name])**2,axis=2))
  blocks.append(dict(name=name,native_pixels_per_feature=scales[name],raw_shape=list(raw.shape),raw_values=fingerprint(raw),learned_offset_distance_native_percentiles=np.percentile(learned,[0,50,90,99,100]).tolist(),total_sample_distance_native_percentiles=np.percentile(distance,[0,50,90,99,100]).tolist(),fraction_total_distance_above_16=float(np.mean(distance>16)),fraction_total_distance_above_32=float(np.mean(distance>32)),tanh_saturation_fraction=float(np.mean(np.abs(np.tanh(raw.astype(np.float64)))>.9))))
 observations.append(dict(id=identifier,input=case['arrays'],parent=case['parent'],output=expected[identifier],blocks=blocks));print(identifier,[(b['name'],round(b['total_sample_distance_native_percentiles'][2],3),round(b['total_sample_distance_native_percentiles'][-1],3)) for b in blocks],flush=True)
 del output,batch,base,value
assert counts==dict(wrapper=6,frozen=6,network=6,sampler=30) and model_hash(module)==before and torch.equal(cpu_rng,torch.get_rng_state()) and torch.equal(cuda_rng,torch.cuda.get_rng_state())
save(root/'result-v1.json',dict(status='six-V172-EMA-replays-offset-usage-observed',protocol=ref(root/'protocol-v1.json'),owner=owner,observations=observations,counts=counts,weights_unchanged=True,RNG_unchanged=True,peak_CUDA_bytes=torch.cuda.max_memory_allocated(),new_parent_DINO_calls=0,new_source_noise_draws=0,new_training_updates=0,scope='Displacement distributions at five nested matching blocks on six reused inputs;not causal influence,full-pipeline receptive field or a new quality/model claim.'))
print('PASS6 exact V172 replays;30 sampler forwards;offset statistics only',flush=True)
